title: Natural Gas Pipeline & Compressor Station Ordinance Extraction Schema
description:
Regulatory requirements for natural gas pipelines, compressor stations, and associated infrastructure.

SCOPE: Natural gas compressor stations, natural gas pipelines (transmission and distribution), metering/regulator stations, oil and gas facilities, and associated equipment.

EXCLUDE: Geothermal wells, wind turbines, solar installations, water/sewer utilities, electric substations, and telecommunications towers.

When extracting from multi-use ordinances, ONLY extract provisions that explicitly apply to natural gas or oil and gas facilities.

document_applicability.description: Scope verification (extraction-quality field, excluded from compiled output).

applies_to_natural_gas.description: Does this document contain provisions regulating natural gas pipelines, compressor stations, or oil and gas facilities?

extraction_approach.description: Which sections were extracted vs excluded. Format: 'Extracted [sections]; Excluded [sections]'

jurisdiction.description: Geographic and temporal context. These fields become row-level context in compiled output.

state.description: US state name or abbreviation exactly as written in document.

county.description: County, city, town, or township name exactly as written.

subdivision.description: Sub-jurisdiction name if applicable. Null if county-level.

jurisdiction_type.description: Type of jurisdiction: County, City, Town, Township, Borough, or Village.

year.description: Year the ordinance was adopted or last amended. Null if not stated.

source.description: URL or document reference for the source ordinance. Use the SOURCE_URL from the CONTEXT block at the top of the document if present.

requirements.description:
Regulatory requirements extracted from the ordinance.

EXTRACTION RULES:

(1) ONE ROW PER REQUIREMENT: Each distinct regulatory provision gets its own row. When a single regulation applies to multiple subjects (e.g., 'setback from property lines and residential structures'), create SEPARATE rows.

(2) RANGES: When setbacks vary by zone (e.g., 100-500 ft depending on zone), extract the range as the value string AND populate min_dist/max_dist.

(3) DAY/NIGHT: When noise limits differ by time, create separate rows with adder='daytime' or 'nighttime'.

(4) PRIORITY FEATURES (extract if present):
   - structures distance, property lines distance, residential zones distance
   - front yard distance, roads distance, water bodies distance
   - schools distance, hospitals distance
   - distance between compressor stations
   - noise (day/night separately)
   - fencing, enclosure, minimum lot size
   - permitted/conditional/special use districts
   - required permits, bufferyard/landscaping

feature.description: Standardized feature name. Use these exact values for cross-jurisdiction consistency.

value.description: Primary quantifiable value. Numbers without units (e.g., 500). Ranges as string (e.g., '100-500'). Zone names for district features. Descriptive text for non-numeric. Null if purely procedural.
examples: AG, RE, SF 8.5, R1, R2, R3

min_dist.description: Minimum distance when value is a range (e.g., 100 for '100-500'). Null if not a range.

max_dist.description: Maximum distance when value is a range (e.g., 500 for '100-500'). Null if not a range.

summary.description: Verbatim or closely paraphrased text from the ordinance supporting this requirement. Include enough context for verification.

notes.description: Additional context not captured elsewhere: measurement conditions, exceptions, cross-references.
